understanding.goal_understanding: Progress through each KA59 level by positioning every selectable piece onto goal tiles marked '+' so that all goals are simultaneously occupied, triggering WIN for the level; repeat until the final level is completed.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: The currently selected piece (shown as 'P' in the semantic grid) moves in 3-pixel cell increments via MOVE actions. If a pushable object is directly adjacent in the movement direction, the piece can push it and both shift together, unless blocked. Walls/boundaries ('#') can prevent or alter movement depending on their specific behavior, so attempted moves are sometimes needed to confirm blocking. Levels can contain multiple selectables; control switches using CLICK on another selectable’s exact pixel-coordinate position (as listed in objects/selectables and player.position). Movement blocked flags are only hints about adjacency and do not guarantee a move will fail.
